name: CO-Bench
description:
CO-Bench: Benchmarking Language Model Agents in Algorithm Search for Combinatorial Optimization
	

This dataset contains the data for the paper CO-Bench: Benchmarking Language Model Agents in Algorithm Search for Combinatorial Optimization.
Code: https://github.com/sunnweiwei/CO-Bench

	
		
		Introduction
	

In this paper, we introduce CO-Bench, a benchmark suite featuring 36 real-world Combinatorial Optimization (CO) problems drawn from a broad range of domains and complexity levels.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CO-Bench/CO-Bench.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate / solution quality (objective value or approximation ratio)
general_score_metric: solution quality (objective value) and approximation ratio; reported success rate across problem instances
reputation: Growing benchmark for evaluating language-model agents on combinatorial optimization; adopted in recent research on LM-driven algorithm search.
